title: ItemSlotView v2 with instant cursor-following tooltips, the held item drawn at the pointer on every screen, and a custom Terraria pointer
player_outcome:
Slots look and feel Terraria-like:
- Coloured by kind: gold for the selected hotbar slot, teal for chests, violet for equipment.
- Icons at the right size, with a bold outlined stack count and the ammo left on guns and bows.
- A gold slot for favourites and faint silhouettes in empty slots.
- A 'grab' sound when items move.

Tooltips appear instantly beside the pointer with coloured lines. The held stack follows the pink Terraria pointer over every panel.
design:
Rewrite game/UI/ItemSlotView.cs, with a split into ItemSlotView.Draw.cs.
- ctor(Func<ItemStack> read, float size, SlotKind kind, TooltipSource? tooltip).
- Properties: Kind, Selected, Locked, EmptyHint (Texture2D), AmmoCount (Func<int>?), Badge.
- `event Action<MouseButton, ClickMods> Clicked`, with modifiers from InputEventMouseButton Shift, Ctrl and Alt.
- Right-button hold while hovered fires Clicked(Right) again at Core HoldRepeat.IntervalTicks, counted in _Process.
- _Process returns early when `!IsVisibleInTree()`. Today 50+ hidden slot views poll every frame.

Drawing, from cached styles:
- UiTheme.SlotStyle(kind: Favorite when the stack is favourited, HotbarSelected when selected; hovered).
- Icon rect is Size·0.62, centred, with TextureFilter LinearWithMipmaps.
- Count at bottom-left in white with a 4 px black outline, font size max(12, Size·0.26), at (Size·0.12, Size−6).
- Badge at top-left, white, 12 px.
- Ammo count (Core PlayerInventory.CountAmmo) at bottom-right, red when 0.
- Empty hint at alpha 0.25; Locked dims the slot.

New game/UI/TooltipFollower.cs, a single instance on CanvasLayer 95.
- A PanelContainer (TooltipPanel style) with a VBox of up to 24 pooled Labels.
- `Show(Control owner, Func<IReadOnlyList<(string, TooltipKind)>> lines, int rarity)` and `Hide(Control owner)`.
- Lines rebuild only when the hovered stack changes, or every 0.25 s for dynamic text.
- Every frame: position = mouse + (16,16), clamped to the viewport. Animated rarities (UiTheme.IsAnimated) recolour the name line.
- Colours: Name → rarity; Good/Bad → green/red; price kinds → coin colours; NoValue → grey; Flavor → Color8(190,200,255); Info → Muted.
- Hides when a Modal gate opens.
- Slot views call Show/Hide on MouseEntered/MouseExited. Godot TooltipText and _MakeCustomTooltip are removed.

New game/UI/CursorItemLayer.cs on CanvasLayer 90. It draws PlayerInventory.Cursor (40 px icon plus outlined count) at mouse + (10,10) whenever the mouse is visible and the cursor is not empty. It replaces the old cursor nodes at InventoryScreen.cs:95-98,146-156.

New game/UI/UiCursor.cs.
- `Apply(UserSettings)`: load res://assets/ui/cursor.png as an Image, multiply by CursorColor, then call `Input.SetCustomMouseCursor(ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(img), Input.CursorShape.Arrow, new Vector2(1,1))`, and the same for PointingHand.
- Called at boot and on UserSettings.Changed.
- The CursorColor default becomes "#ff325f" (Terraria's pink-red).

Sounds: add a 'grab' recipe to tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py, e.g. `blip(900,0.05,'triangle',0.02)` plus a short noise tick, 2 variants, with a GAIN entry. Generate with `/root/bpyenv/bin/python tools/audio/build_audio.py --only=grab --sfx` and commit the WAVs and .import files. Play it on Moved, Equipped and Trashed outcomes.
Update the ctor call sites in Hud.cs:57 and InventoryScreen.cs:186. Create TooltipFollower and CursorItemLayer in WorldLauncher next to the HUD.

Optional, to stop 128→40 px shimmer: rewrite `mipmaps/generate=true` in assets/icons/items/*.png.import with a one-off script, reimport, and check that new icons from build_all.py get the same setting.
UiCommands gains `ui hover <area> <index>`, which shows the follower for that slot. UiProbes gains `ui.tooltip_lines` and `ui.cursor_count`.
files_modify: game/UI/Hud.cs — ctor and SlotKind for the hotbar
game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs — ctor, remove cursor icon nodes
files_add: game/UI/CursorItemLayer.cs — held stack at the pointer on every screen
tests:
ui.cmds:
- `give torch 5` / `ui inventory` / `invclick backpack 3 right` / `assert ui.cursor_count == 1` (cursor probe).
- `ui hover backpack 0` / `assert ui.tooltip_lines >= 3`.
- `ui close` / `assert inv.cursor == 0`.
python3 tools/audio/build_audio.py --check (every Sfx.Play name has a recipe)
verification: dotnet build; headless ui.cmds SMOKE PASS
Lavapipe exec: `--exec="ui inventory;ui hover backpack 0;screenshot slot_tooltip" --shots=$PWD/shots`. Tooltip beside the pointer, coloured name; slot colours match the palette
F3 perf overlay: gd.slot_views ≈ 0 with the inventory closed
risks: Input.SetCustomMouseCursor needs a ≤256 px texture; keep it at 32 px.
Hold-repeat must stop when the mouse leaves the slot or a modal opens.
